notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one additional Zombie.
Prize Pig does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Dark Heart of the Wood by sacrificing Gravecrawler, causing you to gain three life.
Prize Pig triggers, putting three ribbon counters on it, then removing all ribbon counters on it and untapping it.
Activate Prize Pig by tapping it, adding {B}.
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Repeat.
